description:
Search hair and beauty businesses across Turkey — bridal and women's hair salons, barbers, nail studios, beauty centers, spas, laser hair removal and makeup studios — by city, district and category, or with a plain request such as "barber in Kadıköy". Compare ratings, prices, services, working hours and reviews without leaving the chat.
Businesses registered on Randevu Takvimim show their available time slots, and you can book an appointment directly after confirming the time, service and your contact details. Other listings are directory entries compiled from public sources; they are clearly marked as unverified, cannot be booked online and can be reached by phone. Every result links to its page on randevutakvimim.com.

defaultPrompt: İzmir'deki güzellik merkezlerini puan, hizmet ve yorumlara göre karşılaştır
Sultanbeyli'de online randevu alabileceğim bir gelin kuaförü bul ve yarınki boş saatleri göster
